changelog:
v2.11.0 - NEW: DLS Pad (football game controller).

- Floating pad over the game: big neon run-circle joystick + A/B/C buttons positioned where YOUR thumbs rest; taps are injected into the game's own controls.
- Calibrate screen: slide to match where DLS puts its joystick and A/B/C on your screen.
- GAME MODE: freezes all background apps during live matches so nothing competes for CPU/RAM/network - they are restored when you stop. Needs Shizuku.
- Needs Accessibility permission once (Settings > Accessibility > Neverhide GamePad) - the only non-root way to inject touches.
